verdict.headline: NOT YET - no statistically clear edge; the fix behaves like an ordinary price level so far.
details: At the fix level price bounced 36% of the time (393 touches) vs 41% at placebo levels (-5 pts, p=0.0726).
Magnet beta: fix 0.0029 (t=0.24) vs placebo 0.0035 (t=0.36). Negative = price pulled back toward the level.
